answer: Run a gale-window liveness lease: each identity slot is leased, never owned. First, an agent posts a 50-token refundable deposit and a task history. Then the network opens a random 10-minute gale window where the agent must finish 3 live verification tasks. Peers audit the results; failures burn the deposit and the slot ripples to the next honest applicant. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $50,000 in deposits plus 30,000 minutes of live work, since no fable of cheap automation survives a timed check. Like a lighthouse keeper proving he is awake in a storm, presence must be shown, not claimed.
